desc: Identify forbidden rectangle [L,R]x[D,U]; valid blocks = full grid minus hole; answer = (all full-grid monotone paths) - (paths whose first hole cell exists), using first-hit decomposition into start-in-hole, from-below (y=D), from-left (x=L).
Implement StartTerm = sum_{e in hole} out(e) in O(1) via 2D prefix F(I,J)=C(I+J+4,J+2)-(J+3)-(I+1), subtracting the cell count.
Implement TermA (drop if D=0) and TermB (drop if L=0) as O(R-L+1)/O(U-D+1) loops using g(x,y)=C(x+y+2,x+1)-1 and out(x,y)=C(W-x+H-y+2,W-x+1)-1.
Precompute factorials/inv-factorials up to W+H+6; validated on all three provided samples and against brute-force on small grids.
